messages:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — i'm going to open a PR to refresh the Hello Deploy quickstart. target changes: SDK v5 auth flow, add ephemeral key example, and a minimal Dockerfile for first-deploy. opening in ~30m. looking for a devex + eng-runtime reviewer.

Ben Ortiz: SGTM. can you keep the old token-file snippet as a one-line fallback? a lot of users still expect it. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: yeah good call. i'll keep a small `legacy` subsection and mark it deprecated.

Liam Patel: i can review runtime-related bits. watch out for the model param rename — we switched `model_id` -> `model` in runtime v2, so examples need to match. also if you change the example to streaming, note the streaming handler differences.

Maya Chen: thanks — i'll update examples to use `model` and add a non-streaming and streaming variant.

Sara Gomez: quick note about auth snippet: the new recommended pattern is ephemeral keys + short-lived env. propose this snippet:
```js
// server route to mint ephemeral key
import { createEphemeralKey } from 'redwood-sdk/server';
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const key = await createEphemeralKey({ scope: ['generation'] });
  res.json({ ephemeralKey: key });
}

// client
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk/client';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: window.__EPHEMERAL_KEY__ });
```

Sara Gomez: also propose adding this env var name consistently across docs: RW_API_KEY (server) and RW_EPHEMERAL (client injection).

Maya Chen: perfect, i'll use RW_API_KEY and RW_EPHEMERAL.

Ben Ortiz: Dockerfile suggestion (very minimal) — add to the deploy section: 
```dockerfile
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --production
COPY . .
ENV RW_API_KEY=$RW_API_KEY
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

Ben Ortiz: and a short run test: `docker build -t hello-deploy . && docker run -e RW_API_KEY=$RW_API_KEY hello-deploy`

Maya Chen: i'll include both. also adding a short troubleshooting FAQ for common auth errors (401 vs 403 vs missing header).

Liam Patel: small doc test: can we add a tiny `smoke` script in package.json so CI can run quick check against the preview site? e.g. `npm run smoke` that hits `/health` and `/generate`. i can wire the test.

Maya Chen: yes — adding `smoke` and linking to the preview snapshot.

Maya Chen: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1492 — reviewers requested: @Ben Ortiz, @Liam Patel. please ack when you start.

Ben Ortiz: starting review now. quick first pass: wording looks good, only change request is to clarify that ephemeral keys must be minted server-side (i'll add inline).

Liam Patel: i'll review in ~2hrs. if any runtime snippets need a code sample i can paste one.

deploy-bot: Preview build queued for PR #1492 — build id 8812. Preview will be available at https://deploy-preview-1492.redwood.dev in ~5m.

Maya Chen: awesome, thanks. i'll wait for reviews before merging.

Ben Ortiz: left two small comments (typo + missing backticks around `RW_EPHEMERAL`). otherwise looks good. :+1:

Liam Patel: approved, left one nit about stream example (handler should call `client.stream()` not `client.generate()`), pushing a tiny patch to the PR.

Maya Chen: merged after fixes. thanks everyone! closing thread. :tada:
